before_times: new to flying, a student pilot, or a licensed pilot (sets the service: a discovery flight, the next lesson, a solo, a flight review or checkout)
what the lesson is for, and the next stage of training if the student knows it
which aircraft type, if the pilot is checked out in one
for a discovery flight: how many people fly, and whether a guest under 18 is coming
for a flight in the customer's own aircraft (flow B): the airport and the aircraft type
after_time: anything the instructor should know (last lesson's topic, nerves)
for a solo: the practice area or route the instructor agreed
secure_page_only: each person's weight for the flight, for the aircraft's weight limits (never in a text, never through the AI)
the student's date of birth (age limits for solo and for certificates)
proof of citizenship, or the date of the school's federal security approval for a student who isn't a citizen, where the federal rules require it before training
the student pilot certificate and medical certificate: kind and end date (for a solo)
for the customer's own aircraft: the owner's name, the yearly inspection date, and the insurance showing the instructor may fly it
the waiver and the school's training agreement
intake_questions.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for anyone under 18 and signs their OK; a teen who starts a booking forwards the link to a parent

stop.words: an aircraft crash or fire happening now, someone hurt at the airport, an aircraft overdue or missing
stop.say: Call 911 now. Stay clear of any aircraft that is burning or leaking fuel.

go_on.words: feeling sick, very tired, on a new medicine, or drinking in the last 8 hours before a flight
go_on.what: no flying that day for the person at the controls (the federal alcohol rule and the school's own fitness rule); the booking moves with no fee before the cutoff, or turns into a ground lesson; Rosie gives no medical advice

go_on.words: a health condition that may affect flying, a medical certificate that was denied or ran out
go_on.what: it goes on the secure page only; the school decides what may be booked (dual lessons need no medical; a solo does)
the booking goes on; the instructor is told privately to go gently

safety_and_stop_words.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Waiver and training agreement
steps.when: signed on the secure page while booking, before the first flight
steps.who: every person who flies; a parent or guardian signs for anyone under 18; a discovery flight's guest signs their own
steps.result: signed: it books; not signed in the saved time: the time is let go

steps.name: Proof of citizenship, or the federal security approval
steps.when: on the secure page before the first lesson, checked by the school before the first flight
steps.who: every new student pilot, where the federal rules require it
steps.result: checked: training goes on; not checked by the lesson: a ground lesson only, or the lesson moves with no fee

steps.name: Weight for the flight
steps.when: on the secure page while booking
steps.who: everyone who flies, for the aircraft's weight limits
steps.result: inside the limits: it books; over: another aircraft type, fewer people, or no flight, before any money is taken

steps.name: Medical and student pilot certificate
steps.when: before a supervised solo, on the secure page, and shown at the front desk
steps.result: in date: the solo books; missing or ended: a dual lesson instead, or no solo

steps.name: Instructor's solo endorsement
steps.who: the student's own instructor gives it
steps.goodFor: the time the federal rules set (90 days), or as the instructor limits it
steps.result: in date: the solo books; ended: a dual flight first

steps.name: The owner's aircraft papers (flow B)
steps.when: on the secure page before a flight in the customer's own aircraft
steps.result: the yearly inspection in date and insurance that lets the instructor fly it: it goes ahead; missing: the instructor gives ground only, or it moves

first_steps_and_forms.prep: bring the logbook, a photo ID, the headset if you have one, and the student pilot and medical certificates for a solo; eat first; check in 15 minutes early

staff.skills: discovery flights, primary training, instrument, multi-engine, tailwheel, checkout flights, flight reviews, simulator, ground school, stage checks (the chief instructor or a second instructor)
staff.licenses_or_certificates: each instructor's federal flight instructor certificate and ratings are the school's own word, shown to the owner; not checked by Rosie (D96)
staff.supervision: a supervised solo needs an instructor on duty at the school for the whole flight; the student's own instructor gives the endorsement
staff.who_oks: the student's instructor OKs each solo and its weather limits; the chief instructor OKs stage checks and checkride sign-offs; the owner OKs fees, refunds and new renters
staff.stand_in: another instructor with the same ratings may take a lesson, offered to the student first, never assumed; a stage check must be with a different instructor

children_and_age.who_may_book: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for anyone under 18 and signs their OK; a teen who starts a booking forwards the link to a parent
children_and_age.minors_texts: a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian

visit.check_in: at the front desk: the check-in code and the photo ID; for a solo, the student pilot and medical certificates are shown; the class roster for ground school; at the customer's own airport (flow B): the code at the hangar
visit.done: the aircraft's meter reading in and out, the instructor's hours, and DONE; the instructor signs the student's logbook and fills the training record
visit.changes_at_visit: weather or an aircraft defect turns the flight into a ground or simulator lesson, or moves it with no fee; a flight that goes longer than the block is billed at the same rates from the meter, and more than 30 minutes over needs the student's yes first
visit.before_work: the instructor checks the student is fit to fly, checks the weather against the limits, and does the preflight check of the aircraft with the student; no flight if any check fails

license.note: Optional. Upload anything. Rosie never checks it and never shows it as checked (D96).
license.need: none checked by Rosie: a flight school needs no state license in most places; where the state licenses flight schools as private or vocational schools, the business says so (a switch from the state form). Each instructor's federal flight instructor certificate is the business's own word
license.who: the school for its own registration or any school license it holds; each instructor for their own certificate
license.ask: optional: the business registration number and each instructor's certificate number, if the business wants them shown; nothing is asked to be checked
license.insurance: aircraft liability and hull insurance is the school's own matter; optional for the booking
license.background: any background or security check is the school's own step, outside Rosie; Rosie never checks it

never_in_a_text: weight, date of birth, medical certificate details, health answers, citizenship papers and certificate numbers never go in a text: only the secure page
